# Direct dependencies. Install torch first, from the CUDA index:
#   pip install torch==2.14.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130
#   pip install -r env/requirements.txt
# On Colab, keep the preinstalled torch and run only the second command.
#
# KenLM decoding also needs these, installed separately because pyctcdecode pins
# numpy<2, and numpy 1.26 is broken on Python 3.14:
#   pip install --no-deps pyctcdecode
#   pip install pygtrie hypothesis
#   bash scripts/build_kenlm.sh
# env/requirements.lock records the exact versions used for the reported results.
